# Security policy

Security fixes are made for the latest kos-ls release and `main`.

Please do not report vulnerabilities in public issues. Use GitHub's
[private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/Jvaxx/kos-ls/security/advisories/new)
with the affected version, a minimal reproduction and the expected
impact. Ordinary bugs, including crashes on malformed scripts without a
security impact, belong in [issues](https://github.com/Jvaxx/kos-ls/issues).
